ns2:course.label: Seminar in Foods and Nutrition
ns2:course.description: Discusses and evaluates current literature related to specialized topics in foods and nutrition. Prerequisite: Undergraduate degree in foods, nutrition, or comparable background in chemistry, microbiology, physiology, or other biological science; consent of instructor.
